source: torchgfn: A PyTorch GFlowNet library
translation: torchgfn：一个PyTorch生成流网络库

source: Abstract
translation: 摘要

source: The growing popularity of generative flow networks (GFlowNets or GFNs) among a range of researchers with diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise necessitates a library that facilitates the testing of new features (e.g., training losses and training policies) against standard benchmark implementations, or on a set of common environments. We present torchgfn, a PyTorch library that aims to address this need. Its core contribution is a modular and decoupled architecture which treats environments, neural network modules, and training objectives as interchangeable components. This provides users with a simple yet powerful API to facilitate rapid prototyping and novel research. Multiple examples are provided, replicating and unifying published results. The library is available on GitHub (⟦0⟧) and on pypi (⟦1⟧).
translation: 随着生成流网络（GFlowNets 或 GFNs）在具有不同背景和专业知识领域的研究者中日益流行，需要一个库来方便地测试新功能（例如训练损失和训练策略）与标准基准实现的对比，或者在一个共同的环境集合上进行测试。本文介绍了torchgfn，这是一个旨在满足这一需求的PyTorch库。其核心贡献是一个模块化且解耦的架构，将环境、神经网络模块和训练目标视为可互换的组件。这为用户提供了一个简单而强大的应用程序编程接口，以促进快速原型设计和新颖的研究。提供了多个示例，复制并统一了已发表的结果。该库可在GitHub（⟦0⟧）和pypi（⟦1⟧）上获取。

source: 1 Introduction
translation: 1 引言

source: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets, GFNs; Bengio et al., 2021, 2023b) are probabilistic models over discrete or continuous sample spaces with a compositional structure. They are also stochastic sequential samplers that generate objects from a target distribution, which is given by its unnormalized probability mass function⟦0⟧, referred to as the reward function. The rapid growth of GFN research has led to several open-source implementations. While this signals a healthy ecosystem, the majority of the existing open source code is bespoke for a given project, and existing libraries are often tailored for specific domains (e.g., molecular generation⟦1⟧ full applications designed around complex experimental frameworks⟦2⟧, or are more focused on performance than extensibility or ease of use ⟦3⟧ We introduce torchgfn, the first library to offer a general-purpose, highly modular, and usercentric PyTorch-based (Paszke et al., 2019) toolkit designed from the ground up for extensibility and modification. Its design philosophy, centered on the strict separation of concerns, empowers researchers not only to replicate existing work but, more importantly, to accelerate the next generation of GFN research across a wide spectrum of applications. It decouples the environment definition, the sampling process, and the parametrization used for the GFN loss. The library aims to introduce new users to GFNs and their continuous variants (Lahlou et al., 2023; Sendera et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024), and facilitate the development of new algorithms. The library is shipped with many example environments in the Gym which capture various GFN use-cases. source: Figure 1: A schematic of the modular torchgfn repository structure. States and Actions are toplevel abstractions used to interface between the stateless Envs. Containers are generic objects which hold States-Actions sequences drawn from Samplers. These interface (via a PolicyMixin) directly with the parametrization of a GFlowNet subclass (e.g., TrajectoryBalanceGFlowNet) implementing a specific training objective. Parametrization is handled by one or more Estimators (pytorch nn.Module wrappers) which represent the learned function approximators (e.g., policies⟦0⟧, state flows), trained using the GFlowNet’s loss. source: 2 Library Architecture
translation: 2 库架构

source: The conceptual graph of the library hierarchy is shown in Figure 1 (see appendix Figure 2 for a detailed breakdown of the full dependency structure of the library). At a high level, the Markov decision process (MDP) defined over a directed acyclic graph (DAG) is implemented by the interaction of States and Actions via a stateless Env (environment), which produces new States instances. As these elements are intimately tied to the training task, they are defined by the user in one location within the Env itself. State-Action Containers interact with GFlowNets parameterized by Estimators to sample actions (via a Sampler) which explore the DAG. The Estimators are trained using the GFlowNet’s .loss() method, and the interface between these estimators and the sampler is mediated by a PolicyMixin, enabling generic samplers to work with any kind of estimator architecture. A full treatment on each library element is available in appendix B, with up-to-date documentation available in the online documentation⟦0⟧. There are also many working examples in the repo tutorials⟦1⟧.
translation: 库层次的概念图如图1所示（请参见附录图2以详细了解库的完整依赖结构）。总体而言，在有向无环图（DAG）上定义的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）通过状态和动作之间的交互（通过无状态环境）实现，生成新的状态实例。由于这些元素与训练任务紧密相关，它们在环境中的一处由用户定义。状态-动作容器与由估计器参数化的GFlowNets交互，通过采样器抽样动作以探索DAG。估计器使用GFlowNet的.loss()方法进行训练，而这些估计器与采样器之间的接口由策略混合器调解，使通用采样器能够与任何类型的估计器架构一起工作。关于每个库元素的详细说明可在附录B中找到，最新文档可在在线文档⟦0⟧中获取。仓库教程中也有很多工作示例⟦1⟧。

States⟦3⟧ are the primitive building blocks for GFlowNet training objects, which contain state-level metadata such as masks for disallowing undesirable or impossible state transitions. They can be of any datatype, but must be castable to a format compatible with pytorch and/or torch geometric. Actions⟦4⟧ represent the internal actions of an agent building a compositional object. GFlowNets encapsulate the required Preprocessor, Estimator, Sampler, and loss-related logic to produce a trained sampler. source: 2.1 Design Philosophy in Contrast with Other Libraries
translation: 2.1 设计理念与其他库的对比

source: torchgfn is designed as a domain-agnostic, general-purpose library, providing out-of-the-box support for discrete, continuous, and graph-based environments, under a unified API optimized for extensibility. This versatility makes it an ideal platform for foundational research on the GFlowNet framework itself – innovations can be tested on well-understood environments where execution speed and optimization are not the top priority. recursionpharma/gflownet (Bengio et al., 2023a, hereafter recursion) is explicitly specialized for graph and molecular generation, leveraging torch geometric and networkx as its core data representations, while alexhernandezgarcia/gflownet (Hernandez-
translation: torchgfn被设计为领域无关的通用库，提供开箱即用的支持，适用于离散、连续和基于图的环境，并通过统一的应用程序编程接口优化了可扩展性。这种灵活性使其成为研究GFlowNet框架本身的理想平台——创新可以在执行速度和优化不是首要考虑的已知环境中进行测试。recursionpharma/gflownet（Bengio等，2023a，以下简称recursion）明确专门用于图和分子生成，利用torch geometric和networkx作为其核心数据表示，而alexhernandezgarcia/gflownet（Hernandez-

source: Garcia et al., 2023, hereafter gflownet) is most deeply engineered for complex scientific applications such as crystal generation in addition to standard environments, and the JAX-based gfnx (Tiapkin et al., 2025) provides discrete environments and fewer abstractions, in exchange for a JIT-compiled sampling loop with substantial speed advantages. While powerful for their respective domains, each library’s specialization creates barriers for adaptation to certain problem types and fundamental GFlowNets methods (see Table 1). The core abstractions of torchgfn (Sections B.1 to B.7) are compositional objects that can be modified by users to cleanly implement specific or novel methods. For example, the GFN training objective itself is an interchangeable GFlowNet object, clearly separating the algorithm from the neural network models (Estimators). The Sampler and Estimator logic are also disentangled via the swappable PolicyMixin interface.
translation: 加西亚等人（2023年，以下简称gflownet）在复杂科学应用（如晶体生成）以及标准环境方面进行了深入设计，而基于JAX的gfnx（提亚普金等人，2025年）则提供了离散环境和较少的抽象，以换取具有显著速度优势的即时编译采样循环。尽管各自在其领域内功能强大，但每个库的专业化也为其适应某些问题类型和基本GFlowNets方法设置了障碍（参见表1）。torchgfn的核心抽象（第B.1至B.7节）是可组合的对象，用户可以对其进行修改以干净地实现特定或新颖的方法。例如，GFN训练目标本身就是一个可互换的GFlowNet对象，明确区分了算法与神经网络模型（估计器）。采样器和估计器逻辑也通过可交换的PolicyMixin接口得以解耦。

source: Some limitations we intend to address during future development include 1) simplifying the extensible, modular design of States, Actions, and Envs to make environment definition easier and be more compatible with torch.compile, 2) extend the library with real-world tasks containing more complex state spaces relevant to the language model and AI for science communities, 3) supporting hierarchical sampling natively by storing sampling metadata in Trajectories⟦0⟧ 4) support for multi-objective meta-environments, and 5) the inclusion of reinforcement learning baselines. In sum, torchgfn employs a modular architecture that empowers researchers to develop and test new GFN algorithms as self-contained, importable classes, which we believe addresses an unmet need in the GFN community. It represents a significant refinement of GFN building blocks into a set of well-documented and tested abstractions, simplifying experimentation and improving the readability and reproducibility. Our project already has many external contributors and we are in the process of fostering a dynamic developer community for GFNs with proper contribution standards⟦1⟧. We intend for it to become the go-to community standard for foundational research.
translation: 我们在未来开发中打算解决的一些局限性包括 1) 简化 States、Actions 和 Envs 的可扩展模块化设计，使环境定义更加容易，并与 torch.compile 更加兼容，2) 扩展库以包含与语言模型和 AI 科学社区相关的更复杂状态空间的真实任务，3) 原生支持分层采样，通过在 Trajectories 中存储采样元数据实现 ⟦0⟧ 4) 支持多目标元环境，5) 包含强化学习基线。总之，torchgfn 采用了模块化架构，使研究人员能够将新 GFN 算法作为独立且可导入的类进行开发和测试，我们认为这满足了 GFN 社区未被满足的需求。它代表了对 GFN 构建块的重要改进，将其转化为一组文档齐全且经过测试的抽象，简化了实验过程，提高了可读性和可重复性。我们的项目已经有许多外部贡献者，并且正在建立一个具有适当贡献标准的动态开发者社区来支持 GFNs ⟦1⟧ 我们希望它成为基础研究的社区标准。

source: B.1 Environments
translation: B.1 环境

source: In torchgfn, environments⟦0⟧ are stateless objects with a step function which given an action⟦1⟧ and state⟦2⟧ produces a transformed state⟦3⟧ under (⟦4⟧). The stateless nature of the environment is a deliberate design choice which allows for parallelism during training in large scale, multinode settings where queries to the environment (for next state computation and/or reward computation) can be broadcast among as many dedicated compute nodes as required, decoupling the computation bottlenecks potentially imposed when GFlowNet action sampling is significantly faster than environment queries, as is often the case when the environment involves complex energy functions. Environment definition requires the user to specify key components of the MDP, including a representation of the initial state⟦5⟧ and terminal state⟦6⟧ to ensure that the MDP is structured as a pointed DAG (Bengio et al., 2023b), a States class factory that contains the logic governing action masking (i.e., keeping track of and enforcing all allowable actions given the current state), and finally an Actions class factory that defines a representation of sampled actions legible to the environment. Specific environment abstractions are provided, for example, DiscreteEnv allows easily specifying the action space using the total number of actions as an attribute. The environment must either implement a log reward() or reward() method which would be called at every terminating state (i.e., a state with only⟦7⟧ as a child in the DAG) and potentially at non-terminal states if allowed by the environment and the GFlowNet is to be trained using intermediate rewards (Pan et al., 2023)⟦8⟧ When defining an environment, besides s0, users can optionally define a tensor representing the sink state⟦9⟧, which is only used for padding incomplete trajectories. If not specified, sf is set to a tensor of the same shape as s0 filled with⟦10⟧.
translation: 在 torchgfn 中，环境⟦0⟧ 是无状态对象，具有一个给定动作⟦1⟧ 和状态⟦2⟧ 产生转换后状态⟦3⟧ 的 step 函数，该过程遵循 (⟦4⟧)。环境的无状态特性是一种有意的设计选择，它允许在大规模多节点设置中进行训练时实现并行计算，在这种设置中，可以将对环境的查询（用于下一状态计算和/或奖励计算）广播到所需的任何专用计算节点，从而解耦可能由 GFlowNet 动作采样显著快于环境查询所引起的计算瓶颈。定义环境需要用户指定 MDP 的关键组件，包括初始状态⟦5⟧ 和终止状态⟦6⟧ 的表示，以确保 MDP 结构为有向无环图 (DAG)，一个包含管理动作掩码逻辑的 States 类工厂（即，跟踪并强制执行当前状态下所有允许的动作），最后是一个定义可被环境识别的采样动作表示的 Actions 类工厂。提供了特定的环境抽象，例如，DiscreteEnv 允许通过将总动作数作为属性来轻松指定动作空间。环境必须实现 log_reward() 或 reward() 方法，这些方法将在每个终止状态（即，DAG 中只有⟦7⟧ 作为子节点的状态）以及如果环境允许且 GFlowNet 将使用中间奖励进行训练的情况下，在非终止状态调用 (Pan et al., 2023)⟦8⟧。在定义环境时，除了 s0，用户还可以选择定义一个表示汇状态⟦9⟧ 的张量，仅用于填充不完整的轨迹。如果没有指定，sf 将设置为与 s0 形状相同的张量，其中填充⟦10⟧。

source: States

source: are the primitive building blocks for GFlowNet training objects, such as transitions and trajectories, on which losses operate. The provided abstract States class must be subclassed for each environment to define⟦0⟧, and the states shape for a single batch element. This enables the States instance to contain Environment-specific state information, allowing the environment itself to remain stateless. A States object is a collection of states, typically stored as a torch.tensorbased batch for efficient processing. In cases where the environment requires heterogeneous data, such as graphs with varying numbers of nodes and edges alongside global properties, torchgfn leverages numpy.Array (Harris et al., 2020) and tensordict (Bou et al., 2023), a library from the PyTorch ecosystem. Numpy arrays are used for efficient management of torch geometric objects, and TensorDict is a dictionary-like container that holds tensors of different shapes and types while allowing for unified batching and device management operations, leading to cleaner and more efficient code which efficiently manages multiple external pytorch libraries towards the goal of training a GFlowNet.
translation: 是GFlowNet训练对象的基本构建块，如转换和轨迹，在这些对象上执行损失操作。提供的抽象States类必须针对每个环境进行子类化以定义⟦0⟧，并定义单个批次元素的状态形状。这使得States实例能够包含特定于环境的状态信息，从而使环境本身保持无状态。States对象是一组状态的集合，通常存储为基于torch.tensor的批次以实现高效处理。在环境需要异构数据的情况下，例如具有不同数量节点和边以及全局属性的图，torchgfn利用numpy.Array（Harris等，2_020）和tensordict（Bou等，2023），这是PyTorch生态系统中的一个库。Numpy数组用于高效管理torch几何对象，而TensorDict是一个类似字典的容器，可以容纳不同形状和类型的张量，并允许统一的批处理和设备管理操作，从而产生更干净、更高效的代码，有效地管理多个外部pytorch库，以实现训练GFlowNet的目标。

source: Masks:
translation: 掩码：

source: Not all actions are always possible at all states – this constraint is handled by the State’s mask property. DiscreteStates and GraphStates objects (States specialized for environments where states are represented as discrete-variable tensors and graphs, respectively) have both forward masks and backward masks, specifying the actions allowed in each state and the actions that could have produced that state, respectively. Masks can be implemented either as an attribute of the States class, which is kept updated via the update masks method defined in the environment, or as a property, allowing them to be generated on demand at each state. While one can technically train a GFlowNet without masks, the number of invalid trajectories sampled during training may be so great that the loss will not converge in reasonable wall-clock time, so it is almost always a practical necessity and important component of state implementation.
translation: 并非所有动作在所有状态下都是可行的——这一约束通过状态的掩码属性来处理。DiscreteStates 和 GraphStates 对象（分别针对状态表示为离散变量张量和图的环境的状态实现）具有前向掩码和后向掩码，分别指定了每个状态下允许的动作以及能够生成该状态的动作。掩码可以作为 States 类的一个属性实现，并通过环境中定义的更新掩码方法保持更新，也可以作为属性实现，以便在每个状态下按需生成。虽然从技术上讲可以在没有掩码的情况下训练 GFlowNet，但在训练过程中采样的无效轨迹数量可能如此之多，以至于损失函数无法在合理的时间内收敛，因此几乎总是实用的必要条件和状态实现的重要组成部分。

To handle alternative representations, the user must provide a custom Preprocessor to the Estimator when defining your GFlowNet which transforms these data structures into batched tensors.

While it is automatically subclassed for simple discrete environments, it must be manually subclassed in other cases because Actions require knowledge of both the state representation, and therefore the environment. In the DiscreteEnv case, an action is simply an integer representing an index between 0 and⟦1⟧1. For discrete environments, the action set⟦3⟧ contains also a (⟦4⟧)-th exit or terminate action (⟦5⟧), corresponding to the index⟦6⟧

For example, these can hold the outputs of estimators during the sampling of a trajectory to facilitate the calculation of log probabilities when training a model using off-policy methods, as well as other metadata that might be useful for calculating the loss under a particular parameterization. Containers are collections of States, along with other information, such as reward values or densities⟦0⟧). Three containers are available: • Transitions, representing a batch of transitions⟦1⟧.

source: These containers can either be instantiated using a States object or can be initialized as empty containers that can be populated on the fly, allowing the usage of the ReplayBuffer class, to enable experience replay while training your GFlowNet off policy to stabilize training with uncorrelated trajectories (Sutton et al., 1998). They inherit from the base Container class, indicating some helpful methods. In most cases, one needs to sample complete trajectories. From a batch of trajectories, a batch of states and a batch of transitions can be defined using Trajectories.to states() and Trajectories.to transitions(), in order to train GFlowNets with losses that are edgedecomposable or state-decomposable. These exclude meaningless transitions and dummy states that were added to the batch of trajectories to allow for efficient batching.

Our tutorials and examples contain the various implementation details – for example, in the Box environment, the forward policy has support either on a quarter disk or an arc-circle, such that the angle and the radius (for the quarter disk part) are scaled samples from a mixture of Beta distributions⟦0⟧. source: Recurrent Policies:
translation: 递归策略：

source: For sequence models that maintain hidden state (e.g., RNN, or autoregressive Transformers), torchgfn provides RecurrentDiscretePolicyEstimator, which extends the standard policy interface with explicit carry management. The estimator’s forward pass accepts both states and a carry dictionary, returning updated logits and the next carry state. A PolicyMixin architecture allows these recurrent estimators to integrate seamlessly with the library’s sampling and probability calculation utilities through a unified rollout API, handling per-step artifact tracking and context management automatically.
translation: 对于维护隐藏状态的序列模型（例如RNN或自回归变换器），torchgfn提供了RecurrentDiscretePolicyEstimator，该估计器扩展了标准策略接口，增加了显式的携带管理功能。估计器的前向传递接受状态和携带字典作为输入，返回更新后的对数概率和下一个携带状态。通过PolicyMixin架构，这些递归估计器可以无缝地与库的采样和概率计算工具集成，通过统一的展开API自动处理每一步工件跟踪和上下文管理。

source: B.6 Samplers
translation: B.6 采样器

source: Sampler objects define how actions are sampled at each state. They require an Estimator that implements the to probability distribution() method. They also include a method sample trajectories() that samples a batch of trajectories starting from a given set of initial states or⟦0⟧. For off-policy sampling, the parameters of to probability distribution() can be directly passed when initializing the Sampler. Samplers can follow any logic, and users can define their own, which can be passed to GFlowNet to enable new functionality. For example, see the included LocalSearchSampler, which facilitates efficient local exploration by iteratively destroying and re-sampling from high-reward trajectories (Kim et al., 2024). To accommodate diverse policy architectures, torchgfn uses a PolicyMixin framework that provides a uniform rollout API for both vectorized (stateless) and non-vectorized (recurrent) estimators. This mixin exposes methods for initializing rollout context, computing distributions, and evaluating log-probabilities, allowing the Sampler and probability calculators to remain agnostic to whether an estimator maintains internal state. Per-step artifacts such as log-probabilities and estimator outputs are automatically tracked in a RolloutContext, which is managed by the mixin throughout trajectory generation.
translation: 采样器对象定义了在每个状态下如何进行动作采样。它们需要一个实现了to概率分布()方法的估计器。它们还包括一个sample轨迹()方法，可以从给定的一组初始状态开始采样一批轨迹或⟦0⟧。对于离线策略采样，可以直接在初始化采样器时传递to概率分布()的参数。采样器可以遵循任何逻辑，用户可以定义自己的采样器，并将其传递给GFlowNet以启用新功能。例如，请参阅包含的LocalSearchSampler，它通过迭代破坏并重新从高奖励轨迹中采样来促进高效的局部探索（Kim等，22年）。为了适应多样化的策略架构，torchgfn使用了一个PolicyMixin框架，为矢量化（无状态）和非矢量化（递归）估计器提供了一致的展开API。此混合提供了初始化展开上下文、计算分布和评估对数概率的方法，使采样器和概率计算器能够忽略估计器是否维护内部状态。每一步的工件，如对数概率和估计器输出，会自动在RolloutContext中跟踪，该上下文由混合在整个轨迹生成过程中管理。

source: B.7 GFlowNets and Losses
translation: B.7 GFlowNet和损失函数

source: GFlowNets can be trained with different losses, each requiring a different parametrization, so these are available as a unified GFlowNet object in the library. A key architectural feature of torchgfn is the treatment of the GFlowNet loss function as an interchangeable object. A researcher can define a set of Estimators for policies and state flows, and then seamlessly switch the training objective by simply passing these modules to a different GFlowNet class instance (e.g., TrajectoryBalanceGFlowNet, DetailedBalanceGFlowNet, etc.). This compositional approach promotes faster and cleaner experimentation. It is a meta-Estimator that includes one or multiple Estimators, at least one of which implements a to probability distribution() function. They must also implement a loss() function that takes either states, transitions, or trajectories as input, depending on the loss. The implemented losses are the flow matching loss (Bengio et al., 2021), the detailed balance loss (Bengio et al., 2023b) and its modified variant (Deleu et al., 2022), the trajectory balance loss (Malkin et al., 2022), the sub-trajectory balance loss (Madan et al., 2023), and the log partition variance loss (Zhang et al., 2023).
translation: GFlowNets 可以使用不同的损失函数进行训练，每种损失函数需要不同的参数化设置，因此这些作为统一的 GFlowNet 对象在库中可用。torchgfn 的一个关键架构特征是将 GFlowNet 损失函数视为可互换的对象。研究者可以定义一组用于策略和状态流的估计器，并通过简单地将这些模块传递给不同的 GFlowNet 类实例（例如 TrajectoryBalanceGFlowNet、DetailedBalanceGFlowNet 等），无缝切换训练目标。这种组合方法促进了更快和更干净的实验。它是一个元估计器，包含一个或多个估计器，其中至少有一个实现了 to probability distribution() 函数。它们还必须实现一个 loss() 函数，该函数根据损失类型接受状态、转换或轨迹作为输入。实现的损失包括流匹配损失（Bengio 等，2.021 年），详细平衡损失（Bengio 等，2.023b 年）及其修改变体（Deleu 等，2.022 年），轨迹平衡损失（Malkin 等，2.022 年），子轨迹平衡损失（Madan 等，2.023 年），以及对数分区方差损失（Zhang 等，2.023 年）。

source: Appendix C. Sampling Graph Objects
translation: 附录 C. 抽样图对象

source: Sampling a graph is possible in torchgfn using torch.Tensor representations (e.g., building adjacency matrices), which can be suboptimal and quite limited in the general case, or by using the included GraphEnv and GraphStates, which support core operations from torch geometric in the typical torchgfn training setup. This allows for Estimators to be built using GNN-based Estimator, for example, GraphEdgeActionGNN, which assumes a fixed number of nodes and samples only edges between them. The action space for graph building can be whichever subset of valid graph actions required for a task, enabling maximum flexibility for environment designers requiring graph-based states. We have multiple examples in the library, e.g., train graph ring.py and train bayesian structure.py, exemplifying their use, and will continue to build upon this functionality.
translation: 在 torchgfn 中，可以通过使用 torch.Tensor 表示（例如构建邻接矩阵）来抽样图，这在一般情况下可能是次优且相当有限的，或者也可以使用包含的 GraphEnv 和 GraphStates，它们支持在典型 torchgfn 训练设置中的核心操作。这允许使用基于 GNN 的估计器构建估计器，例如 GraphEdgeActionGNN，该估计器假设固定数量的节点并仅采样它们之间的边。构建图的动作空间可以是任务所需的任何有效图动作的子集，从而为需要基于图的状态的环境设计者提供最大的灵活性。我们在库中有多个示例，例如 train graph ring.py 和 train bayesian structure.py，展示了它们的使用，并将继续扩展此功能。

source: Appendix E. Developer Experience and Project Maturity
translation: 附录 E. 开发者体验与项目成熟度

source: For an open-source library, the quality of the developer experience is critical for adoption and longterm success. torchgfn provides a rich learning ecosystem, including documentation on ReadThe- Docs, a quickstart guide, detailed tutorials with runnable scripts and interactive Jupyter notebooks. This comprehensive approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for new users. The library employs a mature testing suite using pytest and enforces code quality with pre-commit hooks. A continuous integration (CI) pipeline managed by GitHub Actions automatically runs tests, validates tutorials, and handles publishing to PyPI. This level of automation and quality assurance is important for a production-ready library. torchgfn utilizes poetry for dependency management via a pyproject.toml file. This modern approach ensures reproducible environments and simplifies package distribution, aligning with current best practices in the Python ecosystem.

translation: 附录E.3 与替代库的性能比较

source: We compared torchgfn, gflownet, and gfnx across nine scenario configurations spanning four environment families as of February 10th, 2026. We ran HyperGrid at three scales: small ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧ state space=8⟦0⟧ ⟦12⟧ 64), medium ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧ state space=16⟦1⟧ and large ⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧ state ⟦17⟧ 32⟦2⟧ 576); Ising at two scales: 6x6 and 10x10; Box2D with either a learned or uniform backward policy; and BitSequence small (sequence ⟦18⟧ word ⟦19⟧ ⟦20⟧ and medium (sequence ⟦21⟧ word ⟦22⟧ ⟦23⟧ All scenarios use Trajectory Balance loss. Across all runs, the GFN policy architecture was matched as closely as possible, with some tolerance for library-specific decisions (for example, the handling of exit actions) leading to a standard deviation of parameter count changes⟦3⟧2%. Each run begins with 50 warmup iterations that are excluded from timing. This allows PyTorch CUDA kernels to cache and JAX functions to JIT-compile, ensuring subsequent measurements reflect steady-state performance. Each of the 100 timed iterations is measured independently using time.perf counter(), with explicit device synchronization before and after each iteration (torch.cuda.synchronize() for PyTorch; jax.block until ready() for JAX) to eliminate asynchronous execution artifacts. Per-phase timing (sampling, loss computation, backpropagation, optimizer step) is recorded where possible; gfnx reports only total step time as its JIT-compiled training step cannot be instrumented without overhead. Each scenario is run at batch sizes 32, 128, and 512 to characterize scaling behavior. gflownet is skipped for Ising 10⟦4⟧10 at batch size 512 due to prohibitive⟦5⟧(batch⟦6⟧ action space ⟦7⟧ trajectory length) scaling in its action indexing. All experiments are repeated across 3 random seeds (0, 1, 2). We report the mean iteration time across seeds, with standard deviation capturing seed-to-seed variability. For each (scenario, batch size, library, seed) combination we record: mean and standard deviation of per-iteration wall-clock time, per-phase timing breakdowns, peak device memory allocation, and total trainable parameter count, which are shown in Table 3. Log partition function estimates were checked before and after training as a sanity check that optimization executed correctly. In Figure 3 a general trend emerges: torchgfn occupies a comfortable middle ground between gflownet and gfnx, with runtimes roughly 2⟦8⟧ faster than the former and 10⟦9⟧ slower
translation: 我们比较了torchgfn、gflownet和gfnx在截至2026年2月10日的四个环境家族中的九种场景配置。我们在三个尺度上运行HyperGrid：小 ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧ 状态空间=8 ⟦0⟧ ⟦12⟧ 64)，中 ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧ 状态空间=16 ⟦1⟧ 和大 ⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧ 状态 ⟦17⟧ 32 ⟦2⟧ 576)；Ising在两个尺度上：6x6和10x10；Box2D使用学习到的或均匀的反向策略；以及小规模BitSequence（序列 ⟦18⟧ 词 ⟦19⟧ ⟦20⟧ 和中等（序列 ⟦21⟧ 词 ⟦22⟧ ⟦23⟧ 所有场景均使用轨迹平衡损失。在所有运行中，GFN策略架构尽可能接近匹配，对库特定决策有一定的容忍度（例如，退出动作的处理），导致参数计数变化的标准差为 ⟦3⟧ 2%。每次运行开始时有50次预热迭代，这些迭代不计入时间测量。这允许PyTorch CUDA核函数进行缓存，并使JAX函数进行即时编译，确保后续测量反映稳态性能。100次计时迭代中的每一次都独立使用time.perf_counter()进行测量，在每次迭代前后进行显式设备同步（PyTorch使用torch.cuda.synchronize(); JAX使用jax.block_until_ready()），以消除异步执行工件。在可能的情况下记录每阶段的时间（采样、损失计算、反向传播、优化器步骤）；gfnx仅报告总步时间，因为其即时编译的训练步骤无法无开销地进行工具化。每个场景在批大小32、128和512下运行，以表征扩展行为。对于Ising 10 ⟦4⟧ 10，在批大小512时跳过gflownet，因为其动作索引存在禁止的 ⟦5⟧ (批 ⟦6⟧ 动作空间 ⟦7⟧ 轨迹长度)扩展。所有实验在3个随机种子(0, 1, 2)上重复进行。我们报告跨种子的平均迭代时间，标准差捕捉种子间的变异性。对于每个（场景，批大小，库，种子）组合，我们记录：每迭代墙钟时间的平均值和标准差、每阶段时间分解、峰值设备内存分配和总可训练参数数量，这些数据展示在表3中。在训练前后检查了对数分区函数估计值，作为优化正确执行的合理性检查。在图3中出现了一种普遍趋势：torchgfn处于gflownet和gfnx之间的舒适中间地带，运行时间大约为2 ⟦8⟧ 比前者更快且达到10 ⟦9⟧ 更慢

source: than the latter. With respect to gflownet, runtime comparisons were heavily dominated by the batch size, trajectory length, and action space of the environment, which is most noticeable in our experiments in the Ising environments. The gflownet library has lower fixed overhead than torchgfn leading to superior performance at small batch sizes, but multiple design decisions of the library prevent the user from leveraging tensor vectorization along the batch dimension and cause runtimes to scale with the batch size. There are also some operations in⟦0⟧ time which can reduce performance with large action spaces. On the other hand, gfnx is able to leverage JIT compilation, providing substantial speedups over torchgfn at all batch sizes. This process highlighted to us multiple design decisions in torchgfn which are incompatible with using torch.compile, such as the structure of our States and Actions classes. We plan to resolve these in a series of improvements on the road map to v3 of the library. We do not have reason to believe that we will be able to fully close the performance gap with JAX, which as a framework is much better suited to fully compiled training loops, but we suspect we will be able to substantially close the gap while retaining the ease of development and extensibility of Pytorch. These benchmark results can be re-computed on demand (using up-to-date commits from all libraries) using the benchmark/ folder now included in the torchgfn repo. We will use this on an ongoing basis to improve the competitive performance of our library relative to it’s peers.
translation: 相较于后者而言，运行时间的比较主要受到批大小、轨迹长度以及环境的动作空间的影响，在我们的伊辛模型实验中这一点尤为明显。gflownet库具有较低的固定开销，因此在小批量情况下表现出色，但该库的一些设计决策使得用户无法利用沿批次维度的张量向量化，并导致运行时间随批大小线性增长。对于较大的动作空间，还有一些操作在⟦0⟧时间内执行，这会降低性能。另一方面，gfnx能够利用即时编译（JIT），在所有批大小下相对于torchgfn提供了显著的速度提升。这一过程使我们认识到torchgfn中存在多个与使用torch.compile不兼容的设计决策，比如我们States和Actions类的结构。我们计划通过一系列改进来解决这些问题，以实现库的v3版本。我们没有理由相信能够完全消除与JAX之间的性能差距，因为作为一个框架，JAX更适合完全编译的训练循环，但我们怀疑可以大幅缩小差距，同时保持Pytorch易于开发和扩展的优势。这些基准测试结果可以根据需要重新计算（使用所有库的最新提交），现在可以在torchgfn仓库的benchmark/文件夹中找到。我们将持续使用这种方法来提高我们库相对于同类库的竞争性能。

source: represent internal actions of an agent building a compositional object: they correspond to transitions⟦0⟧. An abstract Actions class is provided. While it is automatically subclassed for simple discrete environments, it must be manually subclassed in other cases because Actions require knowledge of both the state representation, and therefore the environment. In the DiscreteEnv case, an action is simply an integer representing an index between 0 and⟦1⟧1. Additionally, environments that allow for early termination of trajectories require a exit action tensor corresponding to the termination action ([⟦2⟧1] for discrete environments), unless all trajectories have a fixed length. For discrete environments, the action set⟦3⟧ contains also a (⟦4⟧)-th exit or terminate action (⟦5⟧), corresponding to the index⟦6⟧
